attributes.accessibilityText:
Floating button
A button in the bottom-right corner that plays what you played last.

Period tagged as "NEW"
"NEW" shows on a file added within this period. Currently: 7 days

Recognize .nomedia
Leave out a folder's files when it, or a folder above it, holds a ".nomedia" file.

Show hidden files and folders
Show folders and files whose names start with "." (dot).

Grant access to restricted folders
See the videos inside Android/data and other restricted folders. Also turn on "Show hidden files and folders".

Android/data access
Pair once over Wireless debugging, then open Telegram’s and other apps’ files.
